description: Retrieve user's car rental reservations with filtering options. Shows reservation history, active bookings, and cancellable reservations based on specified criteria. Reads the user's own Enuygun data through their connected account and changes nothing; share it only with that user. Use when the user asks about car rentals they have booked on Enuygun.

filter_type.description: Filter type: 'cancel' for cancellable reservations, 'payment' for payment-related bookings, or 'all' for complete reservation history

name: car_get_reservations
title: My car rental reservations
